notes.title: Devlog 5 - World Editor 2.0
notes.content:
Devlog 5 - Youtube Video
for the first time, i did this Devlog in Video-format. Please check it out and leave some feedback in the comments!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZEgt9yylPkY


Changelog
+ Overhauled Editor UI
+ Implemented Minimap
+ Implemented Worldmap
+ New Tools and Reworks:
* Pencil Tool + Shapes
* Rectangle Tool + Shapes
* Line Tool
* Select Tool (copy+paste+move around selected tiles)
+ Undo+Redo Function
+ Tile Hotbar (9 slots) - customizable
+ New Layer System (all tiles on all layers)
+ New Chunking System

notes.title: Devlog 4 - Regions,Zones, Lighting and Shadows + Image based World Generation
notes.content:
Devlog 4
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45396560/ae1acaba596ea1d66268404cde6ff77f133823cd.png

Changes

 Region Editor Overhaul
 Zone Editor implemented
 Lighting and Shadows


Region Editor & Zone Editor
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45396560/9894c691d1158076268c11708355d59b27439f1f.png


 Region Inventory for managing Regions
 Zone Inventory for managing Zones inside Regions
 Region Editor for drawing Regions with a pencil-brush
 Zone Editor for drawing Regions with a pencil-brush


Regions & Zones are a very important Worldbuilding feature that is directly connected to the Simulation, Rules can be applied on Region and Zone level. (Monster Spawns, Resources)


Lighting & Shadows
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45396560/29d7ed1fa1768ce62b2a8a5f18390212004d8a5a.gif


  New Day&Night Cycle with Lighting and Shadows


i have been working on Lighting and Shadows for a while, to level up the visuals and immersion of the world that you are building and i am very proud of the results.


Image Based World Generation
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45396560/88e123cc6e38f75aeb21d6cda9f00eaa5c4a37aa.png

i have been playing around with image based world generation which i want to integrate as an option into the world generator. in this example i created Skyrim from The Elder Scrolls and it turned out pretty well.

notes.title: Devlog 3 - Seamless World & Editor Overhaul
notes.content:
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45396560/f07b67c5a50e7366dc2014c94df318d7da5b4acd.png

June has been a really good Month for the Game, the playtests have helped improve things alot. Not only have i fixed several bugs that were reported during the Playtests but also improved the World Editor Features thanks to the feedback.

Seamless World
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45396560/16563c12dc7c4823cf872cebca771eda1fdd6074.gif
This was requested by alot of people across Discord and Reddit and i finally tackled the challenge. The World is now completely seamless and you can zoom out to the max - enhancing the feel of the world.

Better Draw Performance
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45396560/552c564898274ab6d0a3e6888bb4e82a53eea68c.gif
Drawing has been optimized to the point where even the biggest radius size runs on stable 60 fps. this has been achieved by reworking the Layer System of the World Editor, more on that later.

Fluent Drawing
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45396560/73f41c10e752d8f7c027d4384f42a4ca50ac9a85.gif
Drawing is now fluent as you were using a real painting tool. Before higher mouse movement would break the fluent drawing. This is now fixed!

New Layer System


  Water Layer
  Land Layer (form continents)
  Biome Layer (put biome type on the land)
  Ground Overlay (put ground variations on any biome)
 Wall and Wall Ceiling Layer (interior,exterior,autotiling cliffs walls etc)
 Object Layer (trees,mountains...etc)
 Effect Layer 
 Region Layer



Ground Variations
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45396560/50b6ae8e823fef7943d04b17ab59be0b9b6a2df8.png

UI Overhaul]
The UI is currently being overhauled:

 The UI is more reactive
 Sound Effects added
 Final Results will be visible in the next Devlog



and much more which i probably forgot.. those are most important Changes.

Playtest Phase 2&3
will start this Weekend. Make sure to join the Discord for your Key!

notes.title: Devlog 2 - Playtests & World Editor Tools
notes.content:
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45396560/f07b67c5a50e7366dc2014c94df318d7da5b4acd.png

Welcome to Devlog 2, in which i talk about the progress in May and the first playtests that will start later this week.



as always, for those that dont want to read a big Wall of text:

Summarized Short-list of Changes

  Reworked the Map Editor Code
  Added Collision Checks for Tile Placement
  Added Tool Modifiers (Scatter,Snap,Grid,Collision)
  UI Changes to display Tool Modifiers
  Reworked the Line and Rectangle tool


Playtests
The first Playtest about all the World Editor Features will most likely happen this Week. Please join our Discord Server for join the Playtester role!

Tool Modifier: Collision
You can activate Collision Placement in the Modifier Panel, it basically will not place your selected tile if it intersects with the collision shape of another tile. You can turn it of anytime if you want specific tiles to intersect. This has been requested by alot of People. If you have more ideas, feel free to join the Discord Community and let us know!
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45396560/f69023ae556d298853ab9b7cfde1c2eb123c9ed8.gif


Tool Modifier: Snap
the snap modifier allows you to snap on the X/Y Axis depending on in which direction your mouse is moving. The snapping starts from the position where your mouse got clicked.
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45396560/e1838347a635fe6757dc200cb762445d0fe68630.gif


Tool Modifier: Scatter
the Scatter Modifier can be used for all tools and will randomly place tiles in the selected area:
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45396560/97af619d59acdf61f4c4cd227da85c9af23ea676.gif


New Features coming to the World Editor:

 Random Tile Placer
the Random Tile Placer lets you configure a pool of tiles that are randomly placed while you draw. For example:  BIOME: GRASSLAND , CATEGORY: VEGETATION , SUBCATEGORY: TREES , then while drawing for each placed tile a random one from the matching filters will be placed.

 Pattern Editor/Placement
the Pattern Editor allows you to select an area on your Map and save all the tiles in it as a Prefab/Pattern. After that you can select that Pattern in your Tile Inventory and placeit elsewhere, across all your Worlds. You can also upload them to the Steam Workshop!

notes.title: Devlog 1 - Modding Support & Creature- and Object Editor Overhaul
notes.content:
Devlog 1 - April
this is the first of the planned monthly devlogs (1st each month) for Fantasy World Manager. We will go through everything that was added or changed in April.

If you are just interested in the shortform, here is a short list of what was done in April:


 Creature Editor was overhauled & Modding Support added
 Object Editor was overhauled & Modding Support added
 3 new classes (Dark Priest, Demonologist, Supreme Necromancer)


scroll down to see more details about each point!

Discord
if you want to make suggestions or help in general, please join our discord community! we are already around 100 people, you will be able to join internal playtests and help me improve the game!


Wishlist Numbers
Its been almost 1 month since i launched the Steampage of Fantasy World Manager and today we crossed 4.000 Wishlists! I never expected that much in the first Month and i really dont take this for granted. I have huge respect for that number.. it means that i have to work harder on delivering a great experience!


Creature Editor Overhaul & Modding Support
+ Combined all Creature Editors into 1 Editor
+ Added Type Selection (ANIMAL,MOUNT,MONSTER,PET,BOSS,NPC)
+ Removed Behavior Settings from the Editor
+ Removed Loot Table from the Editor
+ Added Modding Support (JSON Config with templates)

In general, it is way more simple now and modding (adding your own creatures) is very easy for experienced but also for beginner modders.

Screenshot:
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45396560/6e8e0264988d71cd888a2c4e7225b25cc5d90358.png


Object Editor Overhaul & Modding Support
+ Combined all Editors into 1 Editor
+ Added Type Selection (ITEM,WEAPON,ARMOR,ACCESSORY)
+ Added Loot Table to the Editor
+ Removed Crafting Recipes from the Editor
+ Removed Rarity Modifier Settings from the Editor
+ Added Class Restriction
+ Added Rarity Restrictions 

instead of configuring loot tables for each creature, i decided to configure the creatures that the created item can be dropped from on the item itself, so its easier to manage the loot system. adding your own item sprites is supported in the same way as for the creature editor.

Screenshot:
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45396560/b7fe3a3b9ef50551f19d6dbbb799fda297ae8152.png



New Classes

Dark Priest
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45396560/48db76d31f91517d904dc92741724c13eaf5f500.png

Demonologist
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45396560/fa4d6dd32c01b09b3e793c13de39c289f119a9d2.png

Supreme Necromancer
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45396560/6fc5d5088fca740617410651ca8192ef3a543bd9.png



Plans for May
In May i am aiming for finalizing the following Features:

 Quest Editor
 Event Editor
 POI Editor
 Interior Editor


and preparing the first Playtests! So again -- please join the Discord Server!

notes.content:
